questions.question: When does feedback become infrastructure?
options: When it appears on a dashboard
When it has a path to an owned durable change and verification
questions.explanation: Promotion and ownership turn observation into system learning.

questions.question: Where should a production-write attempt route?
questions.explanation: Unsafe authority is owned by an enforceable policy layer.

questions.question: What should a false positive change first?
questions.explanation: The evaluation layer should preserve the failure as a reproducible case.

questions.question: Why is an owner part of the control?
options: Unowned improvements do not reliably change or stay current
questions.explanation: Someone must implement, verify, review, and retire the action.

questions.question: When should a control be retired?
options: When evidence shows it is superseded, obsolete, or creates more friction than protected risk
questions.explanation: Retirement should be evidence-backed just like promotion.

questions.question: How do shaping and coding-agent feedback connect?
options: Product evidence changes outcome and scope, while agent corrections change the workbench; incidents may change both
questions.explanation: Both tracks use the same ratchet from evidence to durable system change.
